boards.name: 01-fast-tank
boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: GeoGuard enemy body-only keypose concept specification board.
Primary request: a NEW clean landscape cream-white board in exact approved sticker-critter style: warm dark-brown smooth rounded outline, soft coral-red fill, restrained shading, generous cream whitespace. Same canonical camera across all cells. No redesign.
Composition: TWO ROWS, FOUR equal-width isolated cells per row. One identity per row, named at left. Columns1/2/3 are NEUTRAL / SQUASH / STRETCH. Column4 is the identity's body-only ability pose. Eight body drawings total.
ROOT LOCK: each cell has one thin baseline, fine pale vertical center guide and small mint root cross at constant relative coordinates. Feet-ground horizontal midpoint or footless body's ground-projection is the root. Body is rooted in place, local squash/stretch/lean only. Ground root is constant horizontally and vertically between all four poses of a row. Do not recenter using silhouette or make running travel across cells. Feet may bend but midpoint stays on cross. Footless body local lift allowed while ground cross fixed.
All characters in each cell are only that entity's BODY and parent-owned organs/face. NO shadow, particles, glow, speed lines, radial strokes, dust, bullet, arrow, projectile, flame, aura, trail, summon, child, other entity or detached organ in any body cell. Grid, cross and labels are annotation only. Independent effects may be named as tiny footer text ONLY, never drawn. Keep organs attached at same local roots, faces at the same face anchors. No organs added or removed during deformations. Each row must have all four poses with exact organ conservation.
Footer "BODY ONLY / ROOT FIXED" and "MOVE = N → SQUASH → STRETCH → N". Not sprite frames, no continuous animation guarantee.

Input1 is FAST identity/style reference: use ONLY bottom FAST row, ignore green SENTINEL and projectile.
Input2 is TANK identity/style reference: use ONLY bottom TANK row, ignore SHIELD.
Title "FAST + TANK / BODY ONLY".
Row1 FAST: forward-lean round body, exactly2 long back-swept ears,2 short hindfeet,1 side soft flap;2 small dark eyes and1 short oval dark mouth. Coral body. Every pose retains both long ears, both feet and single flap visibly. Column4 label "RUN / CONTACT": modest lean around fixed root; no horizontal traveling, no dust/speed marks. Foot roots remain symmetric around projected cross.
Row2 TANK: wide soft round body, exactly3 upper rounded flesh lobes,2 large fist arms,2 small feet;1 single horizontal dark brow-slot and1 mouth with1 square cream tooth. Brow-slot is one continuous arc, not a pair of new eyes. Same1 square tooth in each pose. Column4 label "CONTACT": fists lift/tense from fixed arm roots, same body position, all three top lobes retain separate silhouettes.
No combat target. RUN is art-only posture, not added dash. HEAVY_MOVE reuses squash.
